title: What color is your aura? Free aura color quiz — cv.cm
description: Free aura color quiz: answer 12 questions to find your aura color, from red, orange and yellow to green, blue, indigo, violet and pink, and what it says about you. Just for fun, no sign-up.
lede: Are you a fiery red, a sunny yellow, a calm blue or a gentle pink? Answer 12 questions about how you think, feel and spend your time to find your aura color.
about: In spiritual traditions, an aura is a field of color said to surround each person and reflect their energy and mood. This quiz matches your personality to one of eight aura colors: red, orange, yellow, green, blue, indigo, violet and pink.

There is no scientific evidence that auras exist or can be seen, so treat your result as a fun way to think about your personality. The questions were written for cv.cm, every color is equally likely, and your answers stay in your browser.

faq.q: What do the aura colors mean?
faq.a: Red is passion and energy, orange creativity and fun, yellow optimism, green growth and care, blue calm and honesty, indigo intuition, violet imagination and vision, and pink love and kindness.
In aura traditions, yes: your color is said to shift with your mood and life. Take the quiz again in a few months and see.

faq.q: What is the rarest aura color?
faq.a: In this quiz, none: every color appears in the same number of answers, so each one is equally likely.

red.name: Red aura
red.body: You are passionate, energetic and fearless. You go after what you want and inspire people with your drive. Your fire can flare into impatience, so give yourself time to cool down before big decisions.

orange.name: Orange aura
orange.body: You are creative, adventurous and full of fun. You love new experiences and bring people together. Make sure your many plans have room for rest.

yellow.name: Yellow aura
yellow.body: You are optimistic, bright and warm, and your good mood rubs off on everyone. You find the upside in almost anything. It's fine to admit when something isn't okay.

green.name: Green aura
green.body: You are caring, grounded and growth-minded. You look after people, plants and yourself, and you feel at home in nature. Remember to accept help as easily as you give it.

blue.name: Blue aura
blue.body: You are calm, honest and a good listener. People trust you with their feelings and you speak the truth gently. Share your own feelings too, not just everyone else's.

indigo.name: Indigo aura
indigo.body: You are intuitive, deep and perceptive. You sense moods and meanings that others miss, and you need quiet time to recharge. Trust your gut, and check it against the facts.

violet.name: Violet aura
violet.body: You are imaginative, visionary and a little unusual. You dream big and want your life to mean something. Turn your best ideas into small first steps so they come true.

pink.name: Pink aura
pink.body: You are loving, gentle and kind, and you make people feel cared for. Romance and friendship are at the heart of your life. Protect your soft heart by setting boundaries.
